name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, install-it-yourself alternative to ElevenLabs that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narration — with no monthly subscription.
buyer: An indie course creator or audiobook publisher who is currently paying ElevenLabs or a voice actor every month and wants that cost to disappear.
business_use_cases: A course creator dubs their English video course into Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese overnight to sell into new markets, without paying per-word to a dubbing studio.
A self-published author turns their ebook into an audiobook using a cloned narrator voice instead of hiring a voice actor for $200+/finished hour.
A law firm or clinic runs dictation locally on-premise so sensitive audio never touches a third-party cloud API.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for people who want the ElevenLabs-quality output without self-hosting, billed by usage.
Sell 'done for you' dubbing as a service to course creators: they send a video, you return it dubbed in 5 languages.

steal_this: Offer course creators a flat-fee 'dub your course into 5 languages this weekend' service — the tool is free, so your only cost is your own time.
